name: fix-trellis-implement-subagent-cwd
title: Fix trellis implement subagent working directory
description: Investigate and fix trellis-implement subagents being launched in another project's directory, causing active Trellis tasks to be unresolved.
creator: lichong
notes: Root cause: the local Trellis extension captured process.cwd() at module initialization instead of resolving each AgentSession workspace from ExtensionContext.cwd.

lastCheck.summary: Independent trellis-check review found no issues; lint, type-check, diff check, cross-workspace context injection, and missing-cwd fail-closed checks passed.
